Team,

Q3 QBR is two weeks out — I want to consolidate a clean forecast and have account-level one-pagers ready for leadership review. Goal: get a single-sheet forecast and a 1-page summary for each top-12 accounts by EOW Tue Jul 14 so the QBR packet is review-ready.

Asks (please):
- AEs: fill the attached q3-account-roster-template.xlsx for each account you own (top-12 prioritized). Include: current ARR, expected close date, confidence %, blockers, and next milestone.
- Mark any account with procurement/legal hold as AT-RISK and flag required artifact (SOC2, contract redline, SSO, etc.).
- If you have a DocuSign out, include the link in the template; if not, note expected signature owner.

Callouts: Nimbus Health (Natalie Brooks) is currently stuck in procurement — Aditya, flag any recent progress in your note so I can brief the execs. Vivek — I think we should escalate one large account (BlueLeaf) if there's no progress by Monday.

Deadline: Tue Jul 14 17:00 PT. I'll consolidate and create the QBR packet Wed morning.

Attachments: q3-account-roster-template.xlsx (attachment)

Thanks — quick and focused here.

—
Marissa Cole
